name: A Devil's Love
source:
A Devil's Markings is about two boys, Prestonal and Keventry, competing for the affection of Emily. 

Emily Bonesa had a loving childhood. Nothing out of the ordinary. A typical lifestyle for the middle class family. It went downhill when Emily's dad became an alcoholic. He would drink his sorrows away after losing his job only to hit and abuse Emily's mom. Her mom was at her limit and decided to leave one day without taking Emily. It's something her mom regrets to this day.

Emily comes off as a fighter through the tough times. She's strong, but vulnerable at times. She, too, has her breaking point. She's seen as someone who's always smiling through thick and thin.

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1356137414/a-devils-love] Kickstarter[/url]]
translation:
《恶魔的印记》讲述了两个男孩普雷斯顿和凯文特里争夺艾米丽的芳心的故事。

艾米莉·博内萨有一个充满爱的童年。没什么不寻常的。典型的中产阶级家庭生活方式。当艾米丽的父亲变成酒鬼后，一切就开始走下坡路了。失业后，他会借酒浇愁，结果却殴打和虐待艾米丽的妈妈。她妈妈已经到了极限，决定有一天离开，不带艾米丽。这件事至今令她妈妈后悔不已。

艾米丽在艰难时期表现得像一名斗士。她很坚强，但有时也很脆弱。她也有她的突破点。她被视为一个无论顺境逆境总是微笑的人。

[来自[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1356137414/a-devils-love] Kickstarter[/url]]
